items.text: Possessing cannabis, hash or cannabis extracts is an offence under the Landsverordening verdovende middelen (art 4). There is no legal threshold, unlike in the Netherlands.
The Public Prosecutor may drop cases for small quantities of soft drugs, but repeat offences, minors or other offences can lead to prosecution.

laws.rule: Possessing cannabis, hash or cannabis extracts is an offence under the Landsverordening verdovende middelen (art 4). There is no legal threshold, unlike in the Netherlands. The Public Prosecutor may drop cases for small quantities of soft drugs, but repeat offences, minors or other offences can lead to prosecution.
Flying a drone is prohibited inside Parke Nacional Arikok.
laws.penalty_signal: Park rule breaches are punishable under AB 2000 no. 59, up to AWG/USD 100,000 as printed on the park sign (figure shown as '$100.000').

laws.rule: In Arikok National Park, disturbing, hunting, trapping or collecting animals, plants or other objects is prohibited, as are metal detectors, geological extraction and rock stacking. Dogs, cats and other domestic animals may not enter.
In Arikok National Park the speed limit is 20 km/h, and vehicles must stay on park roads and use the marked parking. Restricted areas have limited access.

public_holidays: Aruba's own holidays: Betico Croes Day 25 January (2027: Monday), Carnival Monday (2027-02-08), National Anthem and Flag Day 18 March (2027: Thursday).
Also kept: New Year's Day, Good Friday (2027-03-26), Easter Monday (2027-03-29), King's Day 27 April, Labour Day 1 May, Ascension (2027-05-06), Christmas Day and Boxing Day.
moving_calendars: Easter 28 March 2027; Carnival Monday and Ash Wednesday (2027-02-10) are counted from it.

layers.authority: Aruba Conservation Foundation (manages Parke Nacional Arikok)
layers.process: A valid conservation pass is required by law to enter Arikok National Park. A day pass and an annual pass are sold at the Visitor Center at San Fuego (open daily 8:00 to 15:30); the Vaderpiet booth (9:00 to 15:00) sells day passes. The amount was not shown on the foundation's own pages when checked, so confirm it with the foundation (+297 585 1234).
